summary: Borr Drilling Ltd filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 results, disclosing the acquisition of five premium jack-up rigs via a new 50/50 joint venture for a total purchase price of $287 million, completed subsequent to quarter end. The company also refinanced debt through senior secured notes due 2032/2034 and convertible notes due 2033, recording a $176.3 million debt extinguishment charge. The JV structure halves the economic exposure; no premium, price per rig, or advisor was disclosed. Watch for JV financing details and rig integration progress in upcoming quarters.
